create_unipc_multistep_scheduler: create a UniPCMultistepScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and solver order for fast diffusion model sampling
set_timesteps_unipc: set the discrete timesteps and sigmas for the UniPCMultistepScheduler before running inference with a given number of steps
step_unipc_scheduler: predict the sample from the previous timestep by stepping the UniPCMultistepScheduler using model output and current sample
convert_model_output_unipc: convert the raw diffusion model output to the format needed by the UniPC algorithm based on prediction type
add_noise_unipc: add noise to original samples at specified timesteps using the UniPCMultistepScheduler noise schedule
